name: web-page-reader
title: Web Page Reader - Clean Markdown for AI & LLMs
description: Turn any web page, PDF, Word or Excel file into clean Markdown or text for AI agents and LLMs. Falls back to a real browser for JavaScript pages. Pay only for pages that succeed.

urls.title: URLs to read
urls.description: Web pages or document links (PDF, DOCX, XLSX) to convert.

format.title: Output format
format.description: Markdown keeps headings, links and tables.

renderJavaScript.title: Always use a real browser
renderJavaScript.description: Force browser rendering. By default it is used automatically only when a page looks empty.
